transcript: Speaker A: Sir, main aaj chutti lena chahta hoon. [Sir, I want to take a leave today.] Speaker B: Sir, I'd like to take a leave today. Speaker A: Mujhe ek personal kaam hai. [I have some personal work.] Speaker B: I have a personal matter to attend to. Speaker A: Main apna kaam pehle complete kar dunga. [I will complete my work beforehand.] Speaker B: I will complete my work beforehand. Speaker A: Agar zarurat padi toh phone pe available rahunga. [If needed, I will be available on phone.] Speaker B: I will be available on phone if needed. Speaker A: Sir, aap se permission chahiye. [Sir, I need permission from you.] Speaker B: I'm seeking your permission. Speaker A: Are, yeh toh bohot aasan hai! [Oh, this is very easy!] Speaker B: Haan, English seekhna aasan hi hai. Bas tumhein aise practice karte rehna hai aur do hafte mein tumhari English first class ho jayegi. [Yes, learning English is easy. You just have to keep practicing like this and in two weeks your English will be first class.] Speaker A: Yeh main kahan kar sakta hoon? [Where can I do this?] Speaker B: Tumhein bas SpeakeX app download karna hai. Isme mere jaise AI English teacher tumhein bina judgment ke English practice karayenge aur tumhari English farratedar ho jayegi. Jaldi SpeakeX download karo aur do hafte mein apne English se sabko impress karo. [You just have to download the SpeakeX app. In this, AI English teachers like me will make you practice English without judgment and your English will become fluent. Quickly download SpeakeX and impress everyone with your English in two weeks.]

summary: A split-screen ad where a human practices translating common office phrases from Hindi to English with an AI avatar. The avatar promotes the SpeakeX app as a judgment-free tool to practice English and gain fluency in two weeks. The call to action encourages viewers to download the app.
